Title: Azure App Service integrated with Zend Z-Ray

Body.Content: We recently announced a strategic partnership aimed at transforming developers’ productivity in the cloud. Now available as a free preview, this integration of innovative Zend Z-Ray technology with Azure App Service helps offer excellent productivity and insight to PHP developers and developers of PHP-based applications such as WordPress, Drupal, Magento, and Joomla. You can enable Z-Ray for App Service Web Apps in the Settings blade of the Azure portal.
